title: Docker and Kubernetes Security
description: Assess Docker and Kubernetes: exposed Docker socket, privileged containers, host mounts and namespace escapes, Kubernetes API and RBAC misconfiguration, kubelet and etcd exposure, and in-container credential discovery. Use when an engagement includes containers or a cluster, when you land inside a pod, or when reviewing container and Kubernetes hardening.
